breakdown.description: For a two-phase semicrystalline polymer, the measured density should lie between the amorphous and crystalline reference densities, but the setup gives a sample density higher than the crystalline density.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses a measured density of 1.22 g/cm^3, which lies between the amorphous density (1.05 g/cm^3) and crystalline density (1.30 g/cm^3), matching the ground truth. The original incorrect value of 1.42 g/cm^3 (which was higher than the crystalline density) was properly replaced.
